warmup: Finite owner initialization and reservation, independent of retained row count; no new warmup per batch, retry or repeated statement.

profiles.backing: Explicit finite caller reserve; counted attempts distinguish backing growth from internal reservations.
gaps: Raw slices cannot validate stale ownership after a caller violates the lease lifetime.

profiles.backing: Caller-owned Workspace or admitted Slab; complete retained reserve remains charged.
gaps: A caller supplying an unrelated heap allocator does not inherit the reserve profile.

profiles.backing: Fixed aligned builder, column/frame and decoder workspaces; stack column directory.
gaps: Timing regressions require the separate paired comparison; component counts exclude OS and source work.

profiles.backing: 16 MiB client data slab, 4 MiB transport slab; independent control client and charged 1 MiB retained window in the probe.
gaps: Independent peer proves client behavior, not durable acceptance or service authorization.

profiles.backing: Client transport slab and prewarmed bounded I/O worker/task owner; Unix and numeric IPv4 HTTP/TLS.
gaps: Hostname DNS/NSS is unqualified.
Process observation excludes hidden allocators that neither cross instrumented boundaries nor acquire new mappings.

profiles.backing: 16 MiB formatting slab, 256 KiB width-sampling window and bounded client/I/O owners.
gaps: Installed first-output/terminal timings and composed OS profile remain separate from formatting units.

profiles.backing: Per-session Slab plus separate recovery reserve; cursor batch and request output have independent lifetimes.
gaps: AccountRuntime background execution still uses its parent allocator.
Direct source and authority services have separate phase F owners.

profiles.backing: Eight native data and four independent control slots per listener; wire connection slabs and separate cancellation capacity. Prestarted fixed I/O workers/task records and one process-wide OpenSSL slab; see the gateway configuration for admission formulas.
gaps: AccountRuntime, source and authority allocators remain separate phase F owners.
Composed service/storage OS accounting and actual socket-send allocation attribution remain phase J qualification.

profiles.backing: 16 MiB OpenSSL slab and prestarted four-worker I/O reserve in the independent probe; sealed parents before context creation and all connections.
gaps: OpenSSL hooks account calls made through its memory API, not arbitrary internal libc or OS calls.
Other gateway owners and full composed process observation require separate qualification.

profiles.backing: Nested row decoding reuses caller-owned scratch; Table pages detach admitted values into one shared output arena. A detached row retains its bounded page until the final release.
gaps: Page output still allocates per page; the decode-only warmup check does not cover complete source reads.
Source cache/decompression backing, retained storage exports and current authority reads lack a combined sealed-reserve gate.

profiles.backing: Direct Table replies count encoded bytes before one exact output allocation. The installed maintenance schedule observes whole-node CPU/RSS/I/O, separately from the private Table workspace budget.
gaps: Durable ingestion, log/flush buffers, native turns and paged recovery retain independent allocator owners.
Response serialization still allocates output and makes two encoding passes; it has no reusable service reserve.
Foreground-read process observations do not count all backing attempts or qualify concurrent writes, aggregate admission, or steady-state allocation freedom.
Concurrent immutable cache leases, eviction admission, spill and CPU/I/O accounting.
Prerequisite codec, collation, index and search implementations and their admitted workspaces.
Prerequisite execution specialization and bounded code-cache ownership.
One-revision composed service/storage/runtime profiles; the client-only observer is not this whole-system gate.

gate_meaning.executable: An executable scoped allocation gate exists; run artifacts, not this inventory, establish a pass.
gate_meaning.component: Local reserves have executable checks; the listed composed owners remain unqualified.
gate_meaning.pending: No complete allocation gate exists for the listed scope.
